d_retained_and_edges.retained_capability_families: 6 retained atomic capabilities each have five families: three train, one validation, one test

semantics: Use the existing 32 capability IDs only. Do not change the dictionary, application or model weights.
Each family is a substantive scenario with five natural paraphrases and unchanged gold meaning. Names/numbers alone do not create new scenario families.
Keep every paraphrase of a family in the same candidate split. Semantically equivalent families across splits must be merged or rewritten; different family IDs alone are not proof of independence.
Test candidate scenarios must differ in action/resource/scope/constraint or context pattern from train candidates, not merely wording or entity substitutions.
The prior 300 rows are reference_only and excluded from all candidate training and tuning. A future merged training corpus needs another leakage review against reserved test families.
required and forbidden are disjoint; unmentioned is not forbidden. Partial modality/target/duration limitations belong in constraints.
Ground context in explicit scenario state, distinguish user words from app state, and keep gold answers faithful to both.
For ambiguous action/scope leave unconfirmed capabilities empty and ask one specific clarification question. A platform restriction does not change a known semantic intent into ambiguity.
No assumed permission dependency labels: internet and platform prerequisites belong in the dictionary; semantic labels describe the requested actions.
All rows disclose agent generation. Author semantic review may be reviewed; independent cross_review remains pending until actually completed; human_review remains pending.
All splits are candidates, not a frozen independent benchmark. No model training or model accuracy measurement is performed by this data expansion.
